metrics.unavailable_reason: The session collaboration interface does not expose native per-thread token/billing/context telemetry. Values are not inferred from duration or tool counts.

limitations: Single unrandomized shared-host cell with actual fresh agents. One final-LF prompt deviation is disclosed. Synthetic/local stream and filename-only adapter; horizontal attachment scrolling, partial auxiliary localization and inherited bundle-size warning remain. Chromium emulation and controlled timestamped stills only; no physical keyboard, real IME, screen reader, other engine or natural-time playback claim. Resolved native models, roles, tokens, billing and context-pressure telemetry unknown.
